where_to_look: The baseline's 8 matched 'prints' have a 14-day inferred cadence and its own block says cadence_implausible - including a supposed print on 2026-08-26, nine days before this one. These are KNOT's frequent non-earnings 6-Ks (distribution announcements, charter and vessel news, unit issuance) picked up by the results-language matcher. The -10.64% on 2026-03-19 in particular is almost certainly not an earnings reaction. Do not use the 0.89% median as an earnings base rate

For a shipping LP the event is the distribution and the charter book, not EPS. The Q2 2026 cash distribution has ALREADY been separately announced by press release before the results - find it and check whether the coverage ratio implied by it is consistent with the quarter

Charter coverage: KNOP's value is a contracted-revenue schedule of shuttle tankers on time charter to Shell, Petrobras, Equinor, TotalEnergies and Eni. Each new or extended charter is individually press-released. Build the fixture list from the 6-K record since the last results and compare it against the backlog table
Dropdown pipeline from the private parent, KNOT Group / Knutsen NYK - vessels available for dropdown and the financing that would be needed. This is disclosed by the sponsor rather than the LP
The Series A preferred units and the refinancing schedule: KNOP's common distribution was cut once already and the debt maturity wall is the mechanism by which it could change again

Brazil-basin shuttle-tanker demand: Petrobras pre-salt production and offloading data is public and drives utilisation. The unit trades 40k a day with no options chain, so measurement quality is poor even if a finding exists
